name: Skills page and the agent Skills tab show the seeded skills
description: Opens /skills and selects a seeded skill (branch-coverage-rubric) in the card list, checks its Config tab (editor, Save) and its Versions tab, then opens the seeded Test Quality Reviewer and checks its Skills tab lists every skill with the enabled count. Read-only: nothing is created, toggled or saved, no model call.
